terra.problem: “Nobody had to take it on faith alone” overstates the passage. Jesus gave the disciples present evidence of His resurrection, but the passage does not say everyone would receive the same direct evidence.
The summary names forgiveness but omits repentance, which Jesus also says will be proclaimed in His name to all nations.

“Jesus meets you, He settles your doubts, and then He sends you out with joy” turns the disciples’ experience into a promise that every reader’s doubts will be settled and that they will be sent out with joy. The passage does not guarantee this.
